reviews.comment: I went to class less than 6 times this entire semester (3 of which were to take the actual exams). She has practice exams that she posts before each test that are basically the exact same as the actual exam. Just make sure you know how to do each and every question on the practice and it's impossible not to earn an A.
Won't learn anything from this class. Lectures + textbook structure make assignments and exams easy, but don't actually teach you anything.

452 I don't recommend. Use of Pearson resources for homework and lecture slides, which she flys through quickly. Pearson, for some reason, can't produce a well written textbook to save their lives. The book does not have critical formulas and explanations which makes understanding models more complicated than necessary. Avoid.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lowk, just study practice tests and you'll do fine. Better than Strickland lowk.

This is the only B I recieved in my entire college career and no amount of effort put forward by me would have helped. Almost all of the assignments have you randomly assigned to a group, so your grade depends on others. Rubrics provided by Glass are useless; she expects you to be able to read her mind on what she deems a star paper. Avoid.

90% of your grade is tests and the other 10% is online quizzes. Don't go to lectures because you will just get more confused with the material. The best way to succeed in this class is by memorizing the previous exams from Canvas. Dr. Glass is not good as a professor but her class is easy to do well in if you put in SOME effort.
This class is really easy. Do not need to go to class, just take 3 practice tests before the exam and you will be fine as they are practically identical to the real exam.

She reads straight off the slides, gives copious feedback that often shows lack of attention paid to the work in the first place, and is a tough grader in that regard. If you like independent learning she might be for you. 
Assignments almost all group work.
I still got an A, but my experience with her as a professor was difficult to say the least.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A. Do the summaries well because she is a tough grader for the case study. Never attended any of the classes. Make good friends because it's mostly peer reviewed. Do the peer reviews and she will push your grade up if it's on the border. No extra credit whatsoever.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is structure with 5-7 segment summaries where you summarize (w/ 2 other people) her lectures. Due about every two weeks. The TA graded these and got an A. There is a final project where two students work on analyzing FDI for a company. Pretty loose on the topic, but make sure to follow her clear grading criteria.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Awful professor. I took her for two undergrad courses and she was terrible at lecturing but the classes were super easy so I took her again for grad level. Course is only graded on papers and every single one is a randomly assigned group project. She grades extremely strict and will fail you for the smallest errors. Would  drop if wasn't graduating

Do NOT attend the lectures I promise you will gain nothing from it. She's very smart, but she tends to ramble about unimportant material often. Quizzes are a guaranteed 100, you have two attempts. HER EXAMS ARE HER OLD EXAMS. Swear if you memorize her old practice exams and memorize the important slides you will end up with atleast an A.

It is very clear that Amy Glass doesn't know what she's talking about. Sometimes you ask her a question and she answers by rewording her previous sentence. Going to class is pointless since she reads verbatim from the textbook slides which she already puts online. Tests are very similar to previous tests which she also puts online.
The class was super easy, just study the exams. Know how to solve the problems, find resources from online. The Homework are easy, don't show up to class. Easy Econ Elective

Tests are very easy and there is no reason to go to class. Her lectures are tough to get through. Very boring. It does seem like she cares and is willing to answer any questions but no need to ask she gives old tests that are extremely similar to current so do those and you'll be fine. Content isn't anything great either might skip this class.

Extremely boring class and lectures. Posts a zoom link and records lectures, so most students do not attend class. The grade comes from peer evaluations on bi-weeklyish writing assignments and a case study presentation, so do half decent work, or make friends.

Prof Glass's syllabus is simple and there are TWO exam reviews that you can study to easily pass the exams. And you can easily attend her in-person or zoom meeting like its hybrid. One of the best econ prof that finally cares about students and doesn't make things tricky.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Never attended class and always got As on the exams because she gives you multiple past exams that are almost identical. Terrible lecturer but would take her again in a heartbeat because of how easy it was to do well. All I did to study was watch the zoom recordings online a few nights before the exam and practiced the math portions mostly. Easy A

452 is a super easy econ elective to take if you need a light option. Prof. Glass seems nice, but her lectures were boring, as she just read off the slides. I stopped attending class, but completed the assignments based off the slides she posted and did well. She posts her past exams and if you practice those repeatedly you will do fine on exams.

Professor Glass is a terrible teacher. She just reads off slides that are copy pasted from the book and speaks too fast to take solid notes. Don't go to class, just teach yourself the content. The exams are easier than the book. She provides reviews for every exam that are pretty much the same content wise. Just practice these and you'll do well
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was super easy. I stopped going the week after the first exam and hardly watched any of the lectures after that point. She gives you all of the old tests so all you have to do is study them and you are basically guaranteed a 100 on the exam. Easiest 400-level Econ class at TAMU.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Glass is just bad at teaching. Reads from the slides and the slides are basically copy pasted from the book. However, she gives you her previous exams which are very similar to the ones she gives. So read the book and study the previous exams and it's not hard to make an A. Overall bad teacher but tries to make it easy for you

One of the worst professors ive had. She has no idea how to teach she just read off the slides every class. When you tried to ask her questions she would just say the same exact thing but slower. We had about 270 ppl and maybe 15 ppl actually went to class because it was pointless. However, if you study her past tests and the quizzes youll be fine
"If the professor does nothing but sit and dictate notes to you quit the course." -Bishop Fulton Sheen.

Professor Glass was more of a "fill-in" professor for Econ 323. Her lectures are extremely boring and I thought I wouldn't like her at first. But, she gives the class practice exams that are very similar to the test. I think because she does not know the material as well as other professors she makes the test a little easier.

Econ 323 in general is a hard class. Therefore, you have to put in that effort. Although the textbook is required, I studied the previous exams/quizzes the most which helped me out ALOT more. Don't bother going to class, she just reads off the slides. Please do not get discouraged if you fail the first test as I made a 22 and still managed to pass.

Study and practice the problems and past exams and you will do well in this class. Attending lectures is not necessary when you can study a week before an exam and still get an A. The grading criteria looks tough but it isn't that bad if you put in the work
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She doesn't contribute to the class outside of the PowerPoints that are already posted before every class. People stopped showing up after the third class and read the textbook instead and did better. The class is made up of only three test grades, but the practice quizzes and tests are very helpful and similar to the actual exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Amy Glass is a professor in the room to make sure the class happens. Can't ask for much more than that considering what the class is, basic micro economics. Her exams are pretty easy and she gives plenty of practice. She is even putting extra points on the final exam, and gave us a free 10% of our final grade. Cant ask for much more than that.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Does she stick to the power point slides? yes. Is she pretty monotone? yes. Is this the most interesting class i've ever taken? no. That being said, If you read the textbook before going to class, and listen to her lecture you will be fine. Seriously, this class was an easy A. Multiple practice exams posted that are VERY similar to actual exams.

The lectures are read from the slides. Don't even bother to ask questions, this is a 200 person class office hours are minimal and reaching her is more than complicated. Messed up on the first of only three exams and had to Qdrop.

the lectures are straight read off from slides she didnt make. Her lectures are confusing as she goes straight into examples and doesn't explain a thing. she is so monotoned i am always falling asleep. there are no assignments other than 3 test, so if you slip up once youre done for. get ready to use your Qdrop even if it is your prerec
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Possibly the worst professor I've had in terms of ability to teach. Her lecture slides are paragraphs long and look like they are copied & pasted from the hundred of pages she makes you read. All of the writing assignment are busy work and don't challenge students to actually learn the material. Can't learn ANYTHING by taking this course!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I wanted to enjoy this class but she's undoubtedly the worst lecturer that I've had at TAMU (including 323 and 330). Class is her rambling about the some relevant material and some completely unrelated stuff in a monotonous voice. Tests are 75% of class grade with the rest being homework that's unrelated to the test material.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Glass lectures very monotonous, most people don't attend lecture because she reads directly off the slides posted online. Your grade is based on biweekly summaries of lectures/slides and peer reviews of other students (50%). And a case study essay with a presentation that makes up the other 50%. Easy A if you keep with with assignments
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very easy Econ credit. Shes not the best lecture wise but all the information is there for you to do well in the class. Take her you wont regret it.

The class is overall pretty boring but it's an easy A. I stopped going 3 weeks in and studied her previous exams and PowerPoints. Quizzes and problem sets are all easy, just make sure you're keeping up with the schedule. Overall, not the most interesting class but easy A if you study the material you're given.

Class is not horribly difficult, but Glass is easily the worst lecturer I've ever had. Just mumbles directly off slides that she posts online. If you can teach yourself how to do everything off the practice exams you're set. If not.... good luck because you won't be getting any help from her.

I can't even imagine taking this class if you are not an Economics/Business major that deals with math a ton. class is NOT easy and has been changed. The tests are going to be your only grade & multiple choice questions try to trick you (all math based). good luck theres no extra credit.

Only 2 exams and 2 problem sets. She reads directly off the powerpoints in class with no supplemental lecturing, and the powerpoints are made by whoever wrote the book. Not sure how this woman can be teaching a masters level course when she is not even teaching. Study the powerpoints and old exams to do well but good luck.

So boring, never went to class except for review days. She doesn't really seem to care about students. Study her previous exams to do well, though it might be smart to study slides too. She changes up exam questions, so it's not as easy as you think. Quizzes are kinda difficult, some of the answers aren't on quizlet.
Glass just reads off Powerpoint. The exams are easy if you just study the slides and memorize the practice problems. You don't really need to go to class.

Extremely boring lectures with little to no interaction from students. Class size dwindled from 130 in the beginning of the semester to 30-40 people attending lectures towards the end. Would not recommend this course with her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Boring classes, two exams each worth 40%, and two problems set each worth 10%. you will not understand anything from her, just study by yourself. Good luck
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not very enthusiastic about teaching, so her lectures are boring. When students ask questions she gives very vague answers and she is hard to follow. The material is fairly easy though, so the class is doable.

It is very easy to make an A or B in her class b/c her tests are not difficult. Her lectures are boring and not helpful. It seems as though she's talking to her self when she lectures. Even when answering students' questions in class she seems dazed, and her explanations are difficult to understand. You'll make an A but probably wont learn anything
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This professor does not give good lectures, and therefore most of the students in class did not attend except on test days. She posts Power Points on everything she tests over, so it is best to understand what the material means front-to-back because she will warp the questions in a confusing way on her exams. As long as you understand, easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She only lectures Power Point slides during class and if you ask a question she gives a very confusing, long answer. Most of the class did not show up, and for tests you just really need to know the Power Point slide material. Some questions on the exams can be hard to follow, and the practice quizzes/exams do not match the exams given.

Boring lectures and she mumbles off at the end of every sentence... The class got emptier throughout the semester and people started falling asleep. You're pretty much on your own with her - read the textbook to be able to take the tests. She just reads whats on the slides and then goes off on an example for 20 minutes that doesn't even relate.

Lectures are pretty dry and she speaks fairly quickly, but her slides are available online. The book is a very good supplement if you want to truly understand the subject material, and an access code for Pearson is necessary for the HW. Overall a very easy B, and with a little effort you can get an A easily.
